subject: MSA redline: Limitation of Liability carve-outs + prepaid unwind/assistance
messages:
From: Katie Brooks <katie.brooks@helios-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helios-analytics.com>, legal@helios-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: MSA: LoL carve-outs + prepaid refund language

Jordan / Redwood team —

Thanks for sending the MSA and Order Form. Our GC has flagged two interlocking concerns we need clarified before we can execute:

1) Limitation of Liability (Section 9) — Helios requires uncapped liability carve-outs for:
   - Willful misconduct and gross negligence
   - Breach of confidentiality / unauthorized access to customer data (including any PII)
   - IP infringement claims (third-party infringement)

2) Prepaid fees, termination and unwind assistance (Order Form / SOW) — we prepay the first 12 months. If Helios terminates for convenience or Redwood terminates for uncured material breach, we need:
   - Pro-rata refund for unused prepaid months within 30 days of termination (less a reasonable administrative offset)
   - Contractual commitment for a minimum of 30 days of wind-down assistance (data export, handover, runbook access); if additional assistance is required, rate card + estimate to be provided

Those two items interact — our legal team will not accept a blanket LoL cap that would prevent a meaningful refund or exclusion where Redwood is the breaching party or where customer data is exposed.

Attached is a short redline from our side (high level). Can you please confirm Redwood's position on the carve-outs and whether you can accept explicit refund language? If not, we need to understand the alternative remedial mechanics (e.g., service credits, escrow) and who on your team can negotiate.

We prefer to resolve by EOD Fri so procurement can schedule payment. Happy to set a 30-minute call.

Best,
Katie Brooks
Sr. Procurement Manager | Helios Analytics
katie.brooks@helios-analytics.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment: Helios_MSA_highlevel_redline.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Brooks <katie.brooks@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA: LoL carve-outs + prepaid refund language

Katie —

Thanks for the clear note and the redline. Looping in our legal and finance leads (Laura and Aditya) to confirm details. Quick read / proposed commercial compromise from our side:

- Limitation of Liability: Redwood is open to standard carve-outs for willful misconduct, gross negligence, and breaches of confidentiality (including data exfiltration), as well as IP infringement. We typically resist uncapped exposure for general breach claims, but will accept carve-outs for data security and IP as stated.

- Cap level: propose the greater of $2,000,000 or 3x fees paid in the prior 12 months (except for carve-out items above).

- Prepaid refund / termination: we can agree to pro-rata refunds for unused months on termination for convenience. For termination for Redwood's uncured material breach, standard practice is refund of prepaid unused service fees, excluding non-refundable setup/implementation fees. We will also provide 30 days of complimentary wind-down assistance (data export + runbook). Additional support beyond 30 days can be provided per our professional services rates; Laura will add language to the SOW scope and rate references.

If that framework is acceptable, Laura can produce redline language that ties the refund mechanics explicitly to the LoL carve-outs so there is no unintended offset. If Helios needs uncapped LoL for other items, we need to escalate to Aditya for commercial approval.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow (Wed) at 10:00am PT to align?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Brooks <katie.brooks@helios-analytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA: LoL carve-outs + prepaid refund language

Katie / Jordan —

Thanks — I reviewed Helios' summary and have drafted precise redline language we can put into the MSA and Order Form. High-level points below, will circulate tracked changes as an attachment before EOD: 

1) Liability carve-outs (MSA §9):
   - We will include explicit carve-outs for willful misconduct, gross negligence, and breach of confidentiality resulting in unauthorized access to Customer Data.
   - IP infringement: carve-out limited to claims arising from use of our service per the Agreement; we propose Redwood have defense rights but no cap for third-party IP indemnity claims (negotiable).

2) Cap mechanics and refunds:
   - Limitation of Liability shall not limit amounts that are expressly refundable under the Order Form (i.e., pro-rata prepaid refunds). Language will read: "Notwithstanding Section 9, any amounts that Redwood is obligated to refund under the Order Form or SOW shall not be subject to the limitation of liability."
   - Cap will be the greater of $2,000,000 or 3x Fees paid in the prior 12 months, excluding amounts subject to the carve-outs above.

3) Wind-down assistance and SOW references:
   - Add SOW exhibit with 30 days of complimentary transition assistance (data export, standard runbook, and 2 handover calls).
   - Additional work billed at our published professional services rates (referenced in Order Form).

4) Timing and governance:
   - We will return a tracked MSA redline (MSA_redline_20250714.docx) and an Order Form with explicit refund paragraph tonight. Please confirm receipt and call availability if you want to negotiate the cap level with Aditya.

If Helios still insists on uncapped liability for refund amounts in all cases, that will be a commercial escalation (Aditya — happy to review).

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: MSA_redline_20250714.docx (stub)

From: Katie Brooks <katie.brooks@helios-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helios-analytics.com>, legal@helios-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA: LoL carve-outs + prepaid refund language

Jordan / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear path forward. The carve-outs you describe look promising and the explicit "notwithstanding" language for refunds addresses our core concern. A few quick asks before we lock the call: 

- Procurement will need the exact refund calculation example (12-month prepay, termination after month 4 = refund for months 5–12, minus any non-refundable setup fee of $X). Can you include a worked example in the Order Form?
- Can we add a sentence that refunds will be paid within 30 days of invoice/termination?
- We would like the 30 days of transition assistance to include export in a common machine-readable format (CSV/JSON) and a handover checklist.

If you can update the redline with those specifics, we can confirm the call for tomorrow 10:00am PT. If Redwood cannot provide the 30-day payout window, we will need to involve finance to discuss alternatives.

Call confirmed for Thu 10:00am PT — invite to follow.

Best,
Katie
Sr. Procurement Manager | Helios Analytics
